subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: IIT - Roorkee has stated three main findengs in its report.
IIT - Roorkee has stated three main findings in its report.
IIT - Roorkee has statid three main findings in its report.
IIT - Roorkee has stated three main findings in its repourt.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"findings"** means results or conclusions reached after an investigation or research. (निष्कर्ष)

 
 
• **Example: **The **findings **of the survey were quite surprising.
 
 
 
• **"Stated" **refers to something that has been expressed formally or officially. (कहा हुआ)
 
 
• **Example: **The company **stated** its commitment to reducing carbon emissions.
 
 

Therefore, the correct sentence with no spelling error is ** "IIT - Roorkee has stated three main findings in its report. **"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** **Findengs** (निष्कर्ष): The word "findengs" is a misspelling of **"findings"**.

 
 
• **Example:** The report's findengs were not accurate. **(Incorrect)**
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** **Statid** (कहा हुआ): The word "statid" is a misspelling of** "stated"**.
 
 
• **Example:** The professor statid his opinion clearly. **(Incorrect)**
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** **Repourt** (रिपोर्ट): The word "repourt" is a misspelling of **"report"**.
 
 
• **Example:** The repourt was submitted on time.** (Incorrect)**
 
 

32:Tc83,

The correct answer is Option 3)</
